## Buy luggage online – functional, flexible and stylish

Whether for a city break, a business trip or a family holiday – the right luggage is key to a relaxed start to your journey. Depending on the length of the trip and mode of transport, different types of luggage are suitable: softside luggage scores with flexibility and low weight, while hardside luggage impresses with stability and optimal protection – particularly for air travel. Modern suitcases and trolleys with two or four wheels allow for comfortable handling on any surface. Smart features such as extendable telescopic handles or low packing weight make handling even easier. Anyone wanting to buy high-quality luggage online will find a large selection of suitcases, trolleys, bags and sets – tailored to individual needs, type of trip and style preferences.

## From carry-on to XL suitcase: finding the right size

Choosing the right suitcase size depends on the length of the trip and your packing habits. For short trips of up to three days, a carry-on suitcase with a volume of 30 to 49 litres is ideal – many models meet the standard cabin baggage dimensions of 55 x 40 x 20 cm. For trips of up to a week, a piece of luggage with 50 to 69 litres is recommended, while longer stays or long-haul trips require suitcases with more than 70 litres. Luggage models with an expansion function, which offer extra volume when needed, are particularly practical. Business travellers benefit from special business trolleys with a laptop compartment or garment sleeve. Anyone opting for a luggage set gets a coordinated combination of different sizes – ideal for those who want to stay flexible.

## Comfort and technology: modern features for relaxed travel

Luggage doesn't just need to be robust – it also needs to be comfortable and functional. High-quality suitcases offer practical extras such as 360-degree double wheels for greater manoeuvrability, integrated packing straps for crease-free storage or external zip compartments for quick access. Smart luggage with an integrated USB charging function, power bank compartment or digital weighing system is particularly popular. Softside luggage models impress with lightness and stretch, while hardside luggage made of polycarbonate or ABS offers maximum protection at low weight. Anyone who values well-thought-out solutions can buy a complete luggage set online – space-saving and stackable, with a coordinated look.

## More security on the go: modern protective features

Security is a key issue when travelling – especially on longer or international trips. Lockable main compartments, TSA locks and tear-resistant materials protect luggage from unauthorised access or damage. RFID-protected inner compartments also prevent sensitive card data from being scanned. Suitcases with a biometric fingerprint lock are particularly advanced – offering an added boost to both security and comfort. The choice of material can also increase the level of protection: aluminium frames, water-repellent zips or coated fabric make luggage resistant to external influences. Anyone wanting to buy luggage online should pay attention to these features – in an emergency, they can make the difference between security and loss.

## FAQ: Frequently asked questions about luggage

### What is the difference between hardside and softside suitcases?

Hardside suitcases are usually made of polycarbonate or ABS, are dimensionally stable and protect the contents particularly well from pressure and impacts. Softside suitcases made of nylon or polyester are more flexible, often lighter and can be packed more space-efficiently thanks to outer pockets or expansion features.

### What is the difference between a trolley and a spinner?

2-wheel suitcases (trolleys) are pulled behind you at an angle, providing good stability even on uneven surfaces. 4-wheel suitcases (spinners) can be pushed in any direction and moved upright, which is particularly comfortable on smooth ground such as at the airport.

### Which material is the most stable for hardside suitcases?

Polycarbonate impresses with high flexibility and impact resistance at a low weight. ABS is particularly robust, budget-friendly and therefore ideal for uncomplicated everyday use. Aluminium offers maximum stability and a sleek look, but is somewhat heavier as a result. All three materials have their strengths – the right choice depends on your individual usage profile.

### What does "expandable" mean for suitcases?

An expandable suitcase has an additional zip that increases the packing volume by several centimetres. This is practical if you have more luggage on the return journey than on the way there – bear in mind that the expansion can also change the suitcase's external dimensions.

### Which suitcase size fits as carry-on luggage on the plane?

As a rule, a size S suitcase with a maximum external dimension of 55 × 40 × 20 cm (including wheels and handles) fits. Since every airline has its own requirements, we recommend checking your airline's current hand luggage rules before you travel.

### What should I do if my suitcase is damaged during a flight?

Report the damage at the airport directly to the airline before you leave the premises – usually at the baggage desk or Lost & Found. Get written confirmation of the report and document the damage additionally with photos, so you can claim a repair or compensation.

### What is a TSA lock?

A TSA lock can be opened by security authorities, such as US airport security, with a master key, without damaging the lock. This means your suitcase remains secured and protected even during checks, rather than being broken open.

### When should I take a travel backpack instead of a suitcase?

A travel backpack is particularly suitable for trips involving frequent changes of location, uneven terrain or public transport, as it leaves both your hands free and keeps you flexible.

### What is a duffel?

A duffel is a cylindrical travel bag, usually made of robust fabric or leather, with a large main compartment and often additional carrying straps for transport over the shoulder. It is particularly suitable for short trips, sport or as a flexible addition to a suitcase.

### Which luggage is suitable for a family holiday?

For families, a luggage set of several sizes is usually more suitable than a single large suitcase – for example, an L suitcase for the main items and an M suitcase for a second person or children's clothing. A travel bag or backpack is also useful as a supplement for hand luggage, entertainment and snacks on the go. Lightweight, robust models with four wheels also make manoeuvring at the airport easier when several pieces of luggage are travelling at the same time.
